Kei (Design): Uploaded a tighter mock for Alerts > SLO > Notification settings: https://www.figma.com/file/new/alerts-slo. Main asks: compact Notification Preview, clearer suppression UX, and better threshold copy. Quick review please. Rohit (PM): From product: defaults matter. For infra rollouts default suppression = 10m. For customer-facing errors default 0. Show which channels are actually configured. Marta (Frontend): Implementation note: don't live-render every integration. Add a small channel picker in the preview header (Slack/Email/PagerDuty). Render only the selected template, cache sample payloads per workspace. Tess (Writer): Copy suggestions: header "Notification preview"; preview empty: "No connected channels — connect one to preview"; threshold input label "Trigger when error rate >"; suppression label "Suppression window (min)" with helper "Prevent new incidents for N minutes after firing. Events will append to the same incident." aria-bot: Accessibility scan: severity tag contrast fails AA at 14px. Suggest darken to #E08A00. Also add aria-live="polite" and role="region" on preview container:
...
. Presets must be keyboard-focusable. Marta (Frontend): Agree on presets (5m,15m,60m) + numeric input. Use buttons for presets; make numeric input aria-labelled and step=1. Avoid slider. Cache last preset in localStorage per-project. Kei (Design): I'll move channel selector into preview header with a chevron, add skeleton while template loads, update severity colors. Change label from "Snooze" to "Suppression window". Add tiny info icon with the one-line example Tess wrote. Rohit (PM): Also require confirmation modal for sending real test notifications (explicit warning it posts to live channels). Rate-limit test-sends server-side (1 per min/workspace). Tess (Writer): Test modal copy: Title: "Send test notification" Body: "This will post a sample alert to the selected channel. Only send if you have permission to post." Actions: Cancel / Send test. Marta (Frontend): Plan: dropdown + client-side templates + presets + confirmation modal behind a feature flag. I'll add aria attributes and keyboard tests. Kei (Design): Action items: Kei update Figma with presets + new copy + color tweaks. Tess finalize strings. Marta prototype keyboard behavior. Rohit confirm suppression defaults with Ops. Tess (Writer): I'll post final strings by EOD. aria-bot: Reminder: ensure focus ring is visible (>=3px) and hover states keep AA contrast. Rohit (PM): Ok priority list: presets + copy + aria + channel picker for next sprint. Others follow. Kei (Design): Thanks all — will close thread after Figma + copy land. :white_check_mark:
